semiconductor_relevance: High — Jiangsu Lebo Semiconductor Equipment Co., Ltd. specializes in manufacturing and supplying equipment essential for semiconductor fabrication and packaging processes.
summary: Jiangsu Lebo Semiconductor Equipment Co., Ltd. is a dedicated supplier of semiconductor manufacturing equipment, focusing on high-end solutions for various applications. Their product offerings include fully automatic and semi-automatic equipment for processes such as coating, cleaning, etching, and solder reflow, catering to the needs of the semiconductor industry.

regional_presence.China: The company's main manufacturing base is located in Jiangyin City, Jiangsu Province, with an R&D center in Wuxi City, Jiangsu Province.
